renders.prompt: Explain the argument of this song as if to a bright 10-year-old. Short words. Concrete images. No jargon, no Sanskrit terms, no meta-commentary.

paragraphs.text: Whirl the body round and round, then drop it flat toward the earth — the shaking-power cuts out, and the highest state is born. By props or by power, by knowing or by melting the mind — at the end of power's pouring-in: Bhairava-form.
Fix the eyes open and unwinking — freedom is born on the spot. Plug the ears, and the lower gate too — sit clean and picture it: walk into the forever-real.

Stand over a well, over a deep pit, and look — mind in one piece, rightly: mind melts, plainly. Wherever the mind is — outside, inside, anywhere at all — there is the Śiva-state: by all-spreading, where else could it go?

Wherever the road of the eyes runs, knowing shows itself, the all-spreader's own: his, of that stuff only, melting into knowing — full selfness. Even where wants end, those are states too — and the real fills them full.
Leave the mind in the seen thing, in its place — body without props: the lord spreads out. Set the gaze on anything, then draw it back slow — knowing with that knowing: goddess, the open is home.

renders.prompt: Render the argument of this song in a Gen-Z voice: direct, a little feral, zero cringe, no slang overload. Keep every doctrinal claim intact — voice changes, content does not. No new doctrines, no comparisons, no meta-commentary, no quoted terms.

paragraphs.text: Spin the body out, then flat-drop it earthward — shake-power dies and top state is born. Props or power, knowing or mind-melt — at the end of the pour-in: Bhairava-form.
Eyes pried open, zero blinks — freedom drops on the spot. Ears plugged, lower gate too — sit clean and picture it: walk into the forever-real.
Posted over a well, over a deep pit, looking — mind single, done right: mind melts, no notes. Mind anywhere — out, in, wherever — that's the Śiva-state: full-spread, where else is it going.

Wherever the eye-road goes, knowing shows up, all-spreader's property: his stuff only, melting to knowing — full selfhood. Even where the wants run out, those are states too — and the real fills them to the brim.
Mind left in the seen thing, parked in place — body propless: the lord spreads. Gaze on anything, then reel it back slow — knowing-on-knowing: goddess, the open is home.
